chief_complaint: Increasing shortness of breath and swelling in my legs for the past week.
doctor_notes: Patient presented with worsening dyspnea on exertion and bilateral lower extremity edema. Physical exam revealed crackles in the lung bases and 2+ pitting edema.  Likely exacerbation of CHF, likely secondary to medication non-adherence and potential dietary indiscretion.  Blood pressure is elevated, likely contributing to increased cardiac workload.  BNP is significantly elevated, consistent with heart failure.  Encouraged patient to adhere to medication regimen and low-sodium diet.  Discussed importance of daily weight monitoring.

conversation_summary.speaker: Doctor
conversation_summary.text: Hello Mrs. Vance, tell me what's been bothering you.

conversation_summary.speaker: Patient
conversation_summary.text: Doctor, I've been having a lot of trouble breathing lately, and my ankles are so swollen. It's hard to even walk up the stairs.

conversation_summary.speaker: Doctor
conversation_summary.text: I see. When did this start?

conversation_summary.speaker: Patient
conversation_summary.text: It's been getting worse for about a week now. I haven't been taking my pills as regularly as I should have.

conversation_summary.speaker: Doctor
conversation_summary.text: We need to get your fluid levels under control and make sure your heart is being supported properly. I'm going to increase your water pill dosage and we'll adjust your other medications.

conversation_summary.speaker: Patient
conversation_summary.text: Okay, Doctor. I understand. I'll try my best to follow your instructions.

follow_up_actions: Schedule a follow-up appointment in 1 week.
Encourage daily weight monitoring and symptom reporting.
Patient education on low-sodium diet and medication adherence.
